C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to introduce for first reading, proceed by title only, and waive reading in full of
  Ordinance No. 2022­605, amending Title 15 by repealing from Title 15 Sections 15.04.020,
  15.06.020, 15.08.020, 15.10.020, 15.12.020, 15.14.020, 15.20.020 and adding in lieu thereof new
  Sections 15.04.020, 15.06.020, 15.08.020, 15.10.020, 15.12.020, 15.14.020, 15.20.020 to Title
  15 of the Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code to adopt by reference and amend the 2022 Los
  Angeles County Building Code, Electrical Code, Mechanical Code, Plumbing Code, Residential
  Code, Existing Building Code and Fire Code; and set a Public Hearing and consideration of
  second reading for December 13, 2022.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director provided the staff report.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio, to approve
  recommendation.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Roa, Farfan, Del Rio, Gomez
  NOES: 0;

  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0

School and Hawaiian Elementary School, additional trainings will be done the last week of November at

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced updates on the holiday event.
